title: Demo policy: retry window after a failed debit
text: Under the fictional demo policy, a failed SIP debit can be retried within {{retryWindowDays}} calendar days after the failed debit date, and the failure date and final day are both inside the window. This is a fictional demonstration rule, not Groww policy.

title: Demo policy: insufficient funds scenario
text: In the demo scenario, the simulated failed debit is caused by insufficient funds. The fictional demo policy allows a retry inside the retry window. This is a fictional demonstration rule, not Groww policy.

title: Demo policy: retry attempt limit
text: Under the fictional demo policy, a scheduled cycle can have at most {{maxRetryAttempts}} retry attempts. Once the limit is reached, further retries are not eligible. This is a fictional demonstration rule, not Groww policy.

title: Demo policy: monthly SIP amount modification
text: Under the fictional demo policy, the monthly SIP amount can be changed between ₹{{minMonthlyAmount}} and ₹{{maxMonthlyAmount}}, and the change takes effect from the next monthly cycle. This is a fictional demonstration rule, not Groww policy.

title: Demo policy: debit-day modification
text: Under the fictional demo policy, the debit day can be changed between day {{minDebitDay}} and day {{maxDebitDay}}, and the change takes effect from the next monthly cycle. This is a fictional demonstration rule, not Groww policy.

title: Demo policy: SIP restart eligibility
text: Under the fictional demo policy, a paused or stopped SIP can be restarted within {{restartWindowDays}} calendar days of the pause or stop date, including the final day. This is a fictional demonstration rule, not Groww policy.

title: Demo policy: reward progress milestone
text: Under the fictional demo policy, the reward milestone requires {{rewardTargetInstalments}} eligible instalments. Progress is based on paid cycles and the milestone is labelled simulated. This is a fictional demonstration rule, not Groww policy.

title: Demo policy: missed-cycle handling
text: Under the fictional demo policy, a missed cycle delays the reward milestone but does not reset accumulated progress. This is a fictional demonstration rule, not Groww policy.

title: Demo policy: successful retry and reward eligibility
text: Under the fictional demo policy, a successful retry inside the retry window counts as one eligible instalment, and the same scheduled cycle can count only once. This is a fictional demonstration rule, not Groww policy.

title: Demo policy: explicit action confirmation
text: Under the fictional demo policy, a simulated SIP action must be previewed and explicitly confirmed before any state transition is applied. This is a fictional demonstration rule, not Groww policy.

title: Demo policy: simulated action disclaimer
text: The demo policy is fictional and every simulated SIP, payment, reward or restart action is for demonstration only. No real transaction occurs. This is a fictional demonstration rule, not Groww policy.

title: SIP basics: regular investing in a mutual fund
text: AMFI describes a Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) as a method of investing a fixed amount in a mutual fund scheme at fixed intervals, such as once a month, instead of making a lump-sum investment. SIPs are often operated through standing instructions to debit a bank account at regular intervals.
sourceName: AMFI — Association of Mutual Funds in India

title: Market volatility and mutual fund NAV
text: SEBI Investor Education explains that the NAV of a mutual fund can fluctuate with market conditions. When the overall value of the fund's investments rises, NAV per unit can rise; when it falls, NAV can fall.

title: Investment risk in mutual fund units
text: AMFI states that mutual fund schemes are not guaranteed or assured-return products. Investment in mutual fund units involves risks, including the possible loss of principal, and the value of the investment may go up or down.
sourceName: AMFI — Association of Mutual Funds in India

title: No guaranteed returns
text: SEBI Investor Education advises that investing involves potential risks and there are no guaranteed returns. Past performance can provide insights but does not guarantee future returns.

title: Long-term investing and compounding
text: SEBI Investor Education notes that a long investment horizon can allow an investor to benefit from compounding, and that investment choices should be considered alongside financial goals and time horizon.

title: SIP discipline and market timing
text: AMFI describes SIP investing as a disciplined approach in which an investor commits to a fixed sum on a fixed schedule regardless of market conditions. This can help avoid trying to time the market.
sourceName: AMFI — Association of Mutual Funds in India

title: Investor support and grievance redressal
text: SEBI Investor Education explains that an investor with a complaint should first approach the concerned company or intermediary. If still unsatisfied, the investor can use SEBI SCORES, an online grievance redressal platform, to lodge, follow up and track the complaint.

title: SIP compared with lump-sum investing
text: AMFI explains that a SIP invests a fixed amount in a mutual fund scheme at fixed intervals, such as monthly, instead of making a lump-sum investment.
sourceName: AMFI — Association of Mutual Funds in India
